# Phase 3 · Wave 3 gate report (P3-5 / P3-7 / P3-8 / P3-10, P3-2 #5; P3-2, P3-3, P3-6 re-evaluated)

2026-10-03 · branch `design/three-films` · W3 integrated in `79b69b1` (W3-notes), measured in `aabe2a3` / `80a18ef`,
reviewed and audited in `4ba94ad` (`docs/build/p3-handoff/w3/W3-gate-review.md`, `W3-gate-audit.md`), fixed in
`1c93877` (the four W3 fixers + the B1 integrator) and this commit (the gate's own fixes). Headless Chromium 141,
4 CPUs, SwiftShader (software raster and software GL): read absolute frame numbers as relative. Base = the
pre-Phase-3 build `5aa4587` on :3162. Evidence: `docs/build/motion-strips/p3-w3/` — `probes-1440/`, `probes-1024/`,
`probes-1440-rm/` (the final runs), `gate/` (logs, the first runs `*-run1.*`, repeats), `direct/` (the direct
checks and their logs), `beats/beats.json`.

**Verdict. The W3 gate holds.** Every remaining §13 item for P3-5, P3-7, P3-8 and P3-10, and P3-2 #5 (films),
passes or is left only to Aryan, the media lane or a P3-11 judge. The beats probe shows 0 gaps over 100vh, 0
declared-but-missing and 0 undeclared ids and 0 spans under 300 px at both widths; the spotlight log is clean in the
scripted scroll; first load is **JS +4,284 B gz, CSS +6,104 B gz** against base (budget 6,144 each). At 1440 and
1024 every probe passes except games.inp and loaf by duration, both shown to be SwiftShader-only (§3); under
`--rm`, 10 of 10 pass. **Ticked: P3-5, P3-6, P3-7, P3-8, P3-10.** P3-2 (#7, the headless fps and world-font CLS) and P3-3
(#1, the §4.4 intro rows) stay open: both need the P3-11 smoothness captures or a real laptop, and the world-font
fix needs CSS headroom the budget no longer has.

---

## 1. What shipped

**Wave 3 (`79b69b1`, W3-notes):** the drone flight (7 labelled gates, the chalk sprite) and the Dead Eye target
game, the compass toy, the wand and the candles, the 12 egg hosts, the director's cut, the chapter select, the fast
lane, the films screens and their letterbox, the collapses, analytics as a no-op, the lazy horse frames, the
B12 / B45 fly-throughs, the eight in-character titles and four scrubbed sentences, the variant registry rows.

**The W3 fixers (`1c93877`):**
- *GAMES.* The drone lands when its band leaves the view (also mid-landing), a first press under half in view
  centres the band before it can land, Pause / the fast lane land it at once; Dead Eye: the keyboard path is
  `run.ts` alone (egg-runtime's Enter / Esc handler removed), `data-game` clears at the read phase, a round
  releases when `#kill-list` leaves the view and on the fast lane, Fire hands focus to Release, a quick restart
  never inherits the old grade; the grade is a static layer with two 6 % edge bands (rule 35). Both pills are
  plain server markup wired by a new enhancer binder (`components/enhance/binders/games.ts`); leaving
  DESKTOP_FINE ends both games and coming back starts nothing.
- *CHROME.* Pause runs a stop-at-once listener set before `html[data-motion]` restyles the page (Lenis 3 ms,
  sound 4–5 ms); the fast lane moves focus at the click; the chapter select only on "/"; the director's cut
  cancels on input while its chunk loads; the films letterbox is driven from the live frame position (scale 1
  from 85 % to the open); the enhancer binds one binder per idle slice and replays each binder's queued clicks
  right after it binds; `safeLazy` on every desktop extra; the jump code is its own lazy chunk.
- *WORLDS.* The quiet beats `B29-lens` (the ledger) and `B57-roll` (the credits roll); the gull's zone stays
  mounted once reached and the words binder picks up late zones; the candle toy ignores moves without movement;
  one "Built with AI assistance" row before the credits disclosure on every width; chalk.tsx server-only;
  the coin wiring in the hotspots binder; the hotspots binder re-syncs late hotspots while eggs are off; the
  horse follows the manifest variant.
- *PROBES.* words, spotlight, layout-gates, games, hunt, aa-scrim, split, toys, gl probe fixes; a new `nav.mjs`.
- *B1 integrator.* Seams green; flight.ts Pause on the stop-at-once set; the words binder re-scans once per
  mutation burst (47 → 16 scans in a 20 s wheel scroll); the browser data diet drops each variant side's
  `name` and `media` (first-load JS +6,278 → +4,079 B gz); spec rows B29 / B57 and the `--time-scale` note.

**The gate's fixes (this commit):**
- *Dead Eye leaves no trace (P3-8 #5).* The ledger keeps its lens state (open or closed, the row it rests on, the
  tab stop) from the press (`#kill-list[data-deadeye="aim"]`, new; no CSS keys on it) and puts it back on
  release; the centre line stays live (`components/site/ledger-reckoning.tsx`, `components/games/dead-eye/run.ts`).
  Before: the lens was left open on the round's last active row (`closed / ta:all` → `open / ta:survivors`).
- *Dead Eye centres the killed rows (P3-8 #5).* `run.ts` aims the round's scroll from the rows' boxes at the
  press, but the About section reflows during the glide (a late world-font swap, the P3-2 #7 item: 1,378 →
  1,254 px at 1024) and the glide keeps its old target, so the block landed 93 px high at 1440 (top 107 instead
  of 200: the probe's `top ≥ 0` hid it) and at the viewport top at 1024 (`de.start` red 4 of 4 on one build;
  `direct/de-start-1024*.log`). The round now measures again after the glide and aims once more when the block
  moved (> 2 px). Centred at both widths since (200 / 124 px).
- *Step-2 work in turns (P3-2 #9).* A V8 profile through the source maps (`direct/loaf-attr.cjs`,
  `loaf-attr-1440.log`) put the in-window long frames at ladder step 2: the plate engine's parts mounting in one
  commit (`components/stage/stage.tsx`, 21–42 ms) plus every queued ScrollTrigger scene built in one task
  (`lib/use-scroll-scene.ts`, 7–14 ms), 31–72 ms of work per frame. `lib/ladder.ts` gains `nextTurn()` (a few
  waiters per idle slice, one slice per frame); the plate facades (`components/primitives/camera.tsx`
  `usePlateEngine`) and the scroll scenes (8 ms of builds per turn) take turns. After: no frame ≥ 25 ms of work
  in the window in 4 of 4 traced runs (`loaf-attr-1440-after.log`).
- *One decoder through a fade (P3-2 #5).* The decoder probe caught the stage's own loop still decoding in the
  first sample of a stage crossfade at 1024 (2 of 4 runs, y ≈ 13,300–13,500; W2 saw the same once at 1440 and
  called it flaky). The frame loop decides play / pause but applied it through React state a render later,
  while it writes the layers' opacity at once. It now pauses the loop in the same frame as the opacity writes
  (`components/stage/stage.tsx`); the state follows with a nonce so StageVideo re-checks even when a pause and
  a play land in one render (`components/stage/stage-video.tsx`).
- *AA over the live plate (P3-2 #4).* The lit compass bearing ("NW" at rest) is set in `--w-brass`, a decorative
  ink (globals.css: never text); over the About stage plate it dipped to 4.22:1 in one 1024 sample (6 runs).
  On DESKTOP_FINE, where the plate sits behind the scrim, the lit bearing now reads in ink (`text-fg`); phones
  keep the brass on their solid ground. No CSS added (both classes exist).
- *Review #6, finished.* `CardP3` (card-shell) and `HuntPanel` (hunt-chip), the two W2 `lazy()` imports left,
  are `safeLazy` too: a failed chunk leaves the static card / opens nothing, never an application error.
- *Probe tools.* `lenis.mjs`: the fast lane waits until the palette (`#cmd-list`) is gone and times the focus
  move on `focusin` (it moves a few microtasks after the click; the old read waited for a 300–450 ms SwiftShader
  frame); `set()` keeps `null` as a skip (the `--rm` run reported its skipped `desktop` row as a failure).
  `games.mjs` times `drone.pause` in the page from the click (it lands inside the click; the Node-side,
  frame-polled wait read 208–280 ms of round trips and SwiftShader frames). New
  direct checks: `inp-raster.cjs`, `tile-focus.cjs`, `loaf-attr.cjs`; `fastcold.cjs` and `games.cjs` record
  the `focusin` time and the lens.

| build | JS gz | Δ JS | CSS gz | Δ CSS |

JS headroom ≈ 1,860 B gz; CSS headroom 40 B (any CSS addition needs an equal cut). gsap, lenis and
ScrollTrigger stay out of the first load. Rules 33–35: no new rule matches `<html>`; `data-deadeye="aim"` is set by
JS on a section with no CSS keyed on it; no substring selectors; nothing keyed on `html.lenis*`.

### Headless-only failures, shown (not assumed)

- **games.inp (1440 run 1: 544 ms pointerdown).** It is the probe's first drone press, 2.7 s after load, while
  ladder steps 3–5 land (the stage, the GL context, the world fonts). `direct/inp-raster.cjs`, same build, same
  press at the same moment: with Playwright's default launch 16–32 ms; with the runner's SwiftShader GL flags
  80–464 ms, the excess in frames with 0 ms of main-thread work (the GPU process) plus, in 2 of 4 runs, a
  61–72 ms React task of the ladder (the step-2 commit, since split); the same press after the ladder 24–40 ms in
  6 of 6. The Dead Eye interactions (start, marks, Fire) are 24–56 ms under both launches. On the final build the
  probe's worst interaction is still presentation-only (0–2 ms of processing): the first drone press during the
  ladder (776 ms) or the first key in flight (232–496 ms). The key run
  (`direct/inp-raster-1440-keys.log`): 472–608 ms under SwiftShader GL, every overlapping frame 0–3 ms of work;
  16–48 ms with the default launch (`inp-raster-1440-keys-default.log`).
- **loaf by duration.** The probe's default metric; every over-50 frame but the step-2 ones has ≤ 5 ms of work (a
  SwiftShader raster wait). W1 judged #9 by work; so does this gate.
- **sound rm.live** (the CHROME note: "fails on HEAD too"). It passes in every run of this gate (27–31 ms in all six runs
  at both widths); the probe waits for the `emulateMedia` change event, and it arrived each time. No app defect.
